selection: Reference only: per case/per known TRAIN age, minimum quiet/drive-balanced VAL MAE averaged over the same two noise conditions; lexicographic key resolves exact ties. Unseen ages use nearest TRAIN age, lower age on equal distance. Candidate mix_bank_10, all primary forecasts and its prior selection remain unchanged.
pool: 24 new dense augmented +24 dated augmented +24 latency augmented; all24 original dense4s drive ARXs under8heads; saved drive3s, legacy3s and legacy4s each under8heads; all16 previous named frozen/active expert options. 304 declared options per case, not necessarily distinct numerical predictors.
fairness: Same source TRAIN records, roles, channels and dense origin support available to the original physical prior. The original unaugmented4.0s/stride25 fits are retained, including earliest4.0s origins. New age/noise augmented fits start4.25s/stride25 for genuine dated prehistory. Featurizations/objectives/augmentation differ; this is not a claim that every learner uses identical transformed examples.
scope: Stronger reference development on already opened33 Inteco records. Synthetic known-age/noise study and retrospective replay only; no fresh independent data, no primary reselection, no hardware/control superiority claim.
